audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart hands Kayle Levels 3, 4-5 and First item while every prose field says Gwen bullies a dashless, escape-less Kayle through that exact window.
audit.why: Kayle has no dash and no escape; her only lane answer pre-6 is Radiant Blast (Q, 12s at rank 1). Gwen's Skip 'n Slash (E, 13s, refunds on champion hit) reaches her on every step-up. The chart contradicted the whys on the same page.
audit.corrected: Levels 3, 4-5 and First item flipped to Gwen, matching the existing whys and spikes text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment is named everywhere as the pivot but its cooldown is never given, so 'bait it' has no clock.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s. At level 6 a baited ult means the next 160 seconds are free — that is the whole reason the level-6 and Riftmaker spikes are kill windows.
audit.corrected: Real cooldown added to the level-6 spike, the all-in window and the cooldown breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Radiant Blast's resistance shred and Starfire Spellblade's auto-reset were never mentioned, and Celestial Blessing was never named as the heal anti-heal targets.
audit.why: Radiant Blast reduces resistances, which directly devalues Hallowed Mist's bonus armour/MR — the single most important kit-vs-kit interaction here. Starfire Spellblade (E, 8s) is an auto reset whose bonus scales with the target's MISSING health, so it hits hardest at the end of a trade. Celestial Blessing (W) is a flat 15s heal, which is what Executioner's Calling is actually bought for.
audit.corrected: All three stated in Key Ability Interactions, the cooldown breakdown, itemization and whys[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Kayle referred to as 'him'/'his' in several fields.
audit.why: Kayle is female; the surrounding text uses 'her'.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in the fields edited.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Kayle must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online and she has no dash — poke-and-reset on every last-hit. Radiant Blast (Q, 12s) is her only real answer.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Divine Judgment's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your control window: trade whenever Radiant Blast is on its 12s cooldown, bank plates, and deny her the CS that buys her scaling.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Divine Judgment's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it lands, before her ranged-form scaling arrives.

edits.before: Stack snips on the wave and tag him with the true-damage center. Identify how Kayle contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Stack snips on the wave and tag her with the true-damage center. Kayle has no dash here, so every step-up she makes is free damage.

edits.before: Track Kayle's Divine Judgment (Invuln): Her get-out at 6. Bait it. When it is down — Snip her in your mist.
edits.after: Radiant Blast (Q, 12s) shreds resistances — Hallowed Mist's bonus armour and MR are worth less right after it lands.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot vs the poke. Core: Riftmaker  (omnivamp + true-damage ramp), then Nashor's Tooth; boots Mercury's Treads. Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot vs the poke. Core: Riftmaker (omnivamp + true-damage ramp), then Nashor's Tooth; boots Mercury's Treads. Executioner's Calling early — Celestial Blessing (W) is a flat 15s heal.

edits.before: Commit on Divine Judgment's cooldown, on your level-6 spike, and on your Riftmaker timing. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit on Divine Judgment's cooldown — 160s at rank 1 — on your level-6 spike, and on your Riftmaker timing. Her answer goes first.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment: matchup-defining — Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Divine Judgment: 160/120/80s — bait it at 6 and the next 160 seconds are yours. - Starfire Spellblade (E, 8s): auto reset that scales with your MISSING health, hardest at the end of a trade. - Your R: kill windows only.

edits.before: That is Kayle's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: That is Kayle's favourite window — refuse it and half her win condition is gone.

edits.before: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Dropping W early, or trading right after Radiant Blast has shredded your resistances — the mist IS the matchup.

edits.before: Use Divine Judgment invulnerability to deny your all-in and reset the trade
edits.after: Pop Divine Judgment (160s at rank 1) to blank your all-in and reset the trade

edits.before: Skip 'n Slash in, drop Hallowed Mist on yourself, and all-in: she can pop Divine Judgment invuln but it expires and her ranged form is still weak — Needlework's slow keeps her in the mist to finish.
edits.after: Skip 'n Slash in, drop Hallowed Mist on yourself, and all-in: she can pop Divine Judgment, but at rank 1 that is a 160-second cooldown and it expires in seconds — Needlework's slow keeps her in the mist to finish.

edits.before: Q + Skip 'n Slash lets you poke-and-reset on her, and Thousand Cuts heals your return poke — you out-stat a meleed Kayle and deny her levels here.
edits.after: Q + Skip 'n Slash lets you poke-and-reset, and Thousand Cuts heals the return poke; watch her auto wind-up — Starfire Spellblade (E, 8s) is an auto reset.
